text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Time for the athlete's pledge, Trainer♪

With the Summer Training Camp about to 
begin, Super Creek cheerfully called out 
to me beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I, Super Creek, hereby vow to pamper 
Trainer-san to your heart's content this 
summer~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It is our very first summer spending time 
together, after all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll do anything—from preparing meals to 
cleaning your ears and singing lullabies 
for your afternoon nap~♪

It looks like it's going far beyond just 
the royal treatment.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"This summer, I will definitely find the 
breakthrough I need to break out of this 
slump."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful sky, a beautiful sea. Being 
somewhere different from usual is sure to 
lift your spirits~.

A change in environment is certainly a big 
deal, but I don't think that alone will 
solve everything.

What might serve as a clue to the solution 
is that incident before the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best. I need to bring 
Trainer lots and lots of happiness...

The moment she put pressure on herself 
thinking, "I have to do this for Trainer," 
Super Creek's condition took a sharp turn 
for the worse.

This training camp is the perfect 
opportunity to check up on that matter.

And if the cause really is her putting too 
much pressure on herself out of sheer 
kindness...

I have to change Super Creek's mindset. 
During this training camp—without fail.
